title: Field Service Engineer – Automation, Protection & Control Systems (Taubaté/SP)
description:
Job Description Summary

Provide technical expertise in Substation Automation, Protection & Control (P&C) systems, supporting design, configuration, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities across power generation, transmission, and distribution projects;
Ensure reliable system performance through technical analysis, customer support, and field execution while contributing to the successful delivery of automation and digital energy solutions.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Perform design, configuration, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of Substation Automation, Protection & Control (P&C) systems;

  • Lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), and commissioning activities for automation and protection solutions;

  • Configure and validate RTUs, gateways, HMI applications, industrial networks, and communication protocols according to project requirements;

  • Analyze system disturbances, protection events, time synchronization systems, and fault records to ensure operational reliability and performance;

  • Provide technical support to customers and project teams, ensuring compliance with industry standards, safety requirements, and project schedules.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation & Control Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field;

  • Solid understanding of electrical substation processes, equipment, instrumentation, and protection systems for transformers and generators;

  • Knowledge of substation automation architectures, industrial communication networks, and electrical industry communication protocols;

  • Advanced English communication skills, both written and verbal, to support daily interaction with overseas factories and GE Vernova global engineering teams;

  • Spanish language skills are a plus;

  • Availability for frequent domestic and international travel to support project execution, commissioning, and customer activities.

Diversity

GE Vernova is committed to fostering diversity and encourages women, Black professionals, persons with disabilities, members of the LGBTQIAP+ community, and professionals of all ages to apply for this position.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No
